losses.plain: state MSE + progress BCE + 0.5 risk BCE

reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.selection: Check every250 steps. Full/Plain/Direct: minimum dev branch score regret; prediction-only: minimum dev normalized state MSE. Earliest exact tie. Head arms retain existing predicted-score-regret selection. Never select from closed-loop successes.
reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.candidate_rollout: Repeat constant candidate submission; commit one real command then replan each observation.
reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.paired_noise: numpy default_rng(70000+demo_number); same per-step positional Gaussian draws within condition for every method.

inference_ablations.no_risk_score: Same Full checkpoint, risk_weight=0 only; training risk supervision remains. Isolates risk term at decision time.
inference_ablations.no_gate: Same Full checkpoint, gate_margin=0; always choose score argmax.
inference_ablations.horizon4: Same Full checkpoint, prediction horizon=4 rather than8; all candidates and other parameters unchanged.

reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.prediction_only_caveat: Use existing physical_cost on predicted future state, with known bin geometry and holding heuristic. reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.fairness_scope: Matched data, per-seed batches, candidate set and common learned-score controller; Full/Plain share architecture; Direct has matched parameter count, not identical FLOPs. Head calibration has extra training; compare primarily with head_control, not only raw Full.
reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.primary_metric: Per-seed success/30 in each condition, paired episode differences versus BC k2 and matched ablations. Average all three seeds, never choose best seed.
reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over parent episodes per seed; crossed seed and parent bootstrap for mean paired difference. Repeated seeds/conditions are not independent task samples; n=3 seed uncertainty is limited. Descriptive development intervals.
reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.no_tuning: No hyperparameter or seed selection after outcomes; no sealed_test or new confirmation testing in this suite.
reproduction/multiseed_20261012_01/proto.input: 23D privileged simulator state including object state; not vision-only.
limitations: Same fixed BC checkpoint, branch dataset and 30 repeatedly inspected dev parents; seeds vary WM initialization and minibatches only.
